note: Successful is a fair match — a senior network security engineer at one of the largest banks in Egypt is professional standing equivalent to the ICP's examples. Everything else misses. Income was never discussed at any point: no financial question was asked, no plan was offered, and the only signal is his request to defer payment. A $6,000 USD price also carries very different weight against Egyptian professional salaries than against the US prospects this ICP was written around, and nobody on the call tested it. Neglected_health and good_to_great both fail in the same direction — his opening ask is 'I need to lose some weights, regarding to my next marriage', which is weight loss against a deadline rather than a good-to-great upgrade. Not_deconditioned is the closest call in this file. He is roughly 40 lb above his own target at 88 kg and 167 cm, which engages the weight limb of the exclusion, but the second limb plainly does not apply — he is not gym-averse in the slightest, he trains three days a week unsupervised, he bought his own equipment, and he has already lost 6-8 kg by himself. Recorded as a miss because the ICP is written as a single exclusion and the weight limb is met, but the gym-averse half is emphatically false and the rollup should read it that way. The broader finding: this is the second prospect in this batch whose presenting request is the exact phrase the ICP exists to exclude, and again nothing in the process stopped the call being booked or the offer being made.
